# EFTA & Paid in Advance Analysis

## Procedure
Effective Date: 4/25/25 DP17-ESC362.v05

## Purpose
Provide notice of payment changes at least 10 calendar days prior to the ACH draft date
as required by the Electronic Funds Transfer Act (EFTA). Also identify loans where the
Last Analysis Effective Date is >= 11 months prior to the Next Payment Due Date.

## Scope
This procedure applies to the Escrow Analysis Department Associates.

## Procedures

### Monthly Data Export

Within the first 3 business days of the month complete the data export and the initial review.

1. Export the EFTA 94.21 Research report in RIMS and save the file in the archive folder on the M: drive.
2. Create 5 additional tabs within the spreadsheet: EFTA Monthly, EFTA Bi-Weekly, EFTA Combined Daily Review, Bulk Upload and Tax Variance.

### Review Monthly ACH

1. Select monthly on ES_EFTA_94_21_RESEARCH
2. Copy and paste onto Monthly tab
3. Next Payment Due date and select all that is paid ahead
4. Loans that are less than 15 days, highlight in red and add to the EFTA Combined Daily Review tab
5. Highlight the remaining loans in green and add to the bulk upload tab to be analyzed

### Bulk Upload Tab

1. Review all loans for Tax variance
2. Bulk Upload all the loans
3. Bulk Notate all of the loans that were analyzed
4. Follow up the next day and process a DATA Lookup report to confirm all loans were successfully analyzed
